summary: The Drawer sheet draws a 48px chrome band this component does not have, recorded as a known gap. "Drawer Desktop" opens with a row of back and forward chrome controls at the leading edge and a close at the trailing one, p-sm, sitting above the title — where the two mobile panels put the drag handle instead, because a pointer has no drag gesture. It is the same band Sheet.Header shipped as on 2026-08-25 and to the same values, which is unsurprising: both were drawn on this artboard. Drawer has Title, Body and Footer and no Header part, so a caller composing that desktop panel built the row by hand. BUILT the same day as Drawer.Header — see 2026-08-25-drawer-header-ships-and-two-stale. Found while establishing that "Drawer Desktop" is a Drawer rather than a Sheet — all three panels here carry radius-lg on all four corners, a 1px border, shadow-md and a 4px inset, which is this component exactly and which a Sheet never is, being flush to three viewport edges with two corners and no border. That geometric test now sits beside the gesture test in CONVENTIONS §7a, for settling a static drawing where no gesture is visible to read. No code change.
